title: Avocado & Spinach Sourdough Melt
description: Crispy golden toast topped with wilted baby spinach, ripe avocado slices, and melted cheddar.
instructions: Toast sourdough slices lightly in a pan with a touch of butter or olive oil.
Quickly sauté baby spinach until soft (approx. 1 minute).
Layer spinach and ripe avocado slices on sourdough.
Top with sliced cheddar and cover under low heat until cheese melts smoothly.

title: Strawberry Greek Yogurt Compote Bowl
description: Rich creamy Greek yogurt layered with warm simmered strawberry compote and crushed seeds.
instructions: Dice strawberries and simmer in a small saucepan with 1 tbsp water for 4-5 minutes until jammy.
Whisk cold milk into Greek yogurt for desired silky texture.
Spoon strawberry compote over yogurt and serve immediately.

title: Skillet Cheddar & Veggie Omelet
description: Fluffy free-range eggs folded around wilted greens and sharp melted cheddar.
instructions: Beat 2 eggs with a splash of milk and pinch of salt.
Sauté spinach in a skillet with olive oil until tender.
Pour beaten eggs over spinach and cook on medium-low.
Sprinkle cheddar, fold in half, and serve.
